topic: Planning and preparation for a/c detachment and embarkation follow up action post detachment/embarkation.
syllabus_extract: Planning and preparation for a/c detachment and embarkation follow up action post detachment/embarkation.
specific_objectives: 4.1.8.1 Trainee will able explain procedure for planning maintenance of aircraft operating at detachment

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of detachment maintenance checklist; Safety: Verify aircraft status before review; Supervision: Instructor monitors checklist accuracy.
intro_questions: What are the primary objectives of aircraft detachment?
List three key documents required for aircraft embarkation.
How does maintenance planning differ between home base and detachment?

development.content:
Pre-detachment maintenance planning
Embarkation logistics and documentation
Post-detachment follow-up actions

Maintenance scheduling at detachment
Reporting discrepancies to home base
Handling spare parts requisition

Final inspection before return
Documentation closure procedures
Lessons learned from detachment

summary_questions: Explain the critical steps in post-detachment follow-up actions.
Describe how maintenance discrepancies are reported after embarkation.
What documentation must be closed before aircraft return?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief outline for the next lesson plan (LP 02) focusing on specific maintenance tasks at detachment.
